sources.snippet: Fixed jinja chat templates for Qwen 3.5, 3.6 & 3.8 (v22.1) This is a universal drop-in Jinja template that fixes rendering errors, KV cache invalidation, token waste, empty think poisoning, and fatal agentic stalling across official Qwen chat templates.
